notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (in-app help + doc search + ticket triage). Current provider: VendorX (OpenAI-compat). Goal: migrate to Redwood Hosted for day-to-day, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Key asks: prompt parity with minimal UX diffs, reranking/embeddings at scale, SSO + audit logs, pricing within ARR band.

POC details / engineer notes:
- Eval harness: 200 canonical customer queries + 50 edge cases from real tickets. A/B against VendorX. Acceptance criteria: <=5% difference in key quality metrics (top-1 relevance, extractive overlap) and no regressions in saved summaries.
- Compatibility layer: team requested a thin OpenAI-compat shim to minimize prompt churn. SE note: shim feasible — map safety/stop tokens, adapt temperature defaults, normalize streaming chunks.
- Observed regressions: templated multi-turn prompts occasionally changed sentence structure (affects UI diffing). Two prompts where paraphrase changed label mapping in product UI. Action: create prompt-preservation tests and add prompt-presets in Redwood Console.
- Latency: Hosted perf is acceptable for interactive flows (median 85ms/token), but need to prove sustained throughput for nightly rerank jobs on Dedicated.
- Cost sensitivity: Product team expects cost per 1M tokens to be <= current VendorX costs or justify savings via batching/kv cache.

Stakeholder quotes / highlights:
- "We can't ship if UX copy shifts — must match existing responses closely or we need manual QA for hundreds of prompts." — VP Product
- "Dedicated is attractive for predictable cost, but procurement needs a 12-mo visibility on ARR and SLA." — Head of Ops

Docs & links: Pricing deck + POC notes in drive. Fireflies on demo and mid-POC call attached. Jira tickets opened for two parity regressions (RED-4321, RED-4387).

Open questions / risks:
- How large is the engineering lift for the compat layer and ongoing maintenance? SE estimate: 2-3 sprints to cover templating edge cases.
- Quantization/regression risk when moving to Dedicated (different kernel/quant path) — need focused regression suite.
- Legal wants KMS integration and data residency statement before Dedicated contract.

Recommended next steps (short):
1) Finish hosted POC acceptance tests by 2026-03-18 (Diego assigned).
2) Prepare pricing scenarios: Hosted-only vs Hosted→Dedicated migration with estimated year-1 spend and break-even (Maya + finance).
3) Technical deep-dive on Dedicated runtime differences and regression mitigation (runbook + test harness) — schedule week of 2026-03-22.
4) Send SOC2/SAML/KMS artifacts to legal (Asha to own).

CRM shorthand / recent activity:
- choppy notes from PM, wants parity guarantee.
- engineering team very pragmatic, cares about minimal prompt churn.
- procurement timeline: target Apr 2026 contract.
